summary: TransAlta Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 results news release and reaffirmed full-year guidance. Reported adjusted EBITDA of $264 million versus $238 million a year earlier, free cash flow of $93 million ($0.29 per share), and net earnings attributable to common shareholders of $63 million ($0.20 per share). Management noted the October completion of the Colorado gas asset acquisition and monetization of a minority interest in its Oklahoma wind portfolio, plus temporary mothballing of Battle River units and an extended Sundance 6 outage. No special-situation transaction terms were disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings report.
